intent: Split the largest focus_owner Kotlin test file under the cap, and record why the Kotlin sources and the second test file cannot follow.
scope: Not split: EnforcementRunner.kt (564), DevicePolicyBridge.kt (415), FocusPolicy.kt (277), EnforcementDecision.kt (274), EnforcementLogTest.kt (251)
changes: The shared policy builders, the home coordinates and the installed-package set moved to an internal EnforcementFixtures object, and both test classes delegate to it. Kotlin has no part/part of, so an object in the same package is the equivalent - a plain second class could not see the originals' private members.

EnforcementRunner.kt was examined and left alone: its location block reads the private constructor property `context` and the private prefs() six and five times respectively, so extension functions cannot reach them.

EnforcementLogTest.kt is one line over the cap and was reverted after a split attempt: it defines helpers (`candidate`, `window`) between its test methods rather than in a fixture block, so any cut leaves unresolved references. One line is not worth restructuring a test file for.

verification.evidence: BUILD SUCCESSFUL. Two compile failures first, both real: 'Unresolved reference installed' when a fixture was missed, then the same for the log test's inline helpers.

verification.command: sum the tests= and failures= attributes across build/app/test-results/testDebugUnitTest/*.xml
verification.evidence: 40 tests, 0 failures, now across 3 XML result files instead of 2 - matching the baseline of 40 measured before any edit. Gradle reports UP-TO-DATE rather than a count, so the XML is the only way to see it.
EnforcementDecisionTest.kt is gone from the list. Five Kotlin files remain, four of them sources with the shared-state problem and one a test that is one line over.

risks: JAVA_HOME must be pinned to JDK 21 for this build; the default JDK 26 breaks the AGP jlink transform. Any future session running these tests needs the same prefix.
Four Kotlin sources stay over the cap. Splitting EnforcementRunner means passing context and the prefs accessor explicitly, which changes its constructor contract.
rollback: git revert the commit; EnforcementDecisionTest.kt returns to 418 lines and the two new files disappear.
After rollback, re-run the gradle unit tests and expect 40 tests, 0 failures.
